english_definition: A place where public transport buses stop to allow passengers to board or leave.
a terminal/node where subways/rapid transit systems load and unload passengers
A bus used for a touring group, especially by musicians.

A document issued to a specific person by a government authority, permitting this person to drive one or more classes of motor vehicle on public roads and highways, often used as an identification document.
A building or structured facility designed primarily for the storage of vehicles, usually automobiles, in designated parking spaces.
ride away on a horse, for example
A sign for the control of traffic or the information of drivers.
A distance that a person can reasonably walk.
A wheel-shaped control that is rotated by the driver to steer, existing in most modern land vehicles.
Synonym of pull in (To park frontways in a parking spot)
